Sourdough starter pancakes

Every starter needs feeding, and every feeding leaves discard. This is what to do with it.

Ingredients

  • 200 g starter discard
  • 1 egg
  • 120 ml milk
  • 1 tbsp sugar
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda

Method

  1. Whisk the starter, egg and milk.
  2. Add the dry ingredients and rest for ten minutes.
  3. Cook in a hot pan until bubbles form, then flip.
